findings.title: No test covers the new `unchanged` branches in main's result or the renderer toast
findings.body: The flag is pinned at the `relocateWorkspace` level (`relocate.test.ts:158`). Nothing checks that `relocateFolder` in `index.ts:349` forwards it to the IPC result, or that `onRelocated` here stays silent when it is set. The dialog test (`workspace-dialog.test.tsx:283`) only covers the changed case. If either end drops the flag, picking the current folder shows "now points to the new folder" again and every test stays green. A small provider test with `{ ok: true, unchanged: true }` that asserts no toast would pin it.

contracts.action: Picking the folder a workspace already points at returns `unchanged: true` and the renderer shows no toast
contracts.equivalent_path: Changed-folder path: `relocateActive` or `registry.relocate`, then the probe, `broadcastState` and the `folderChanged` toast.
contracts.before_after: The unchanged path skips the transaction (no save prompt, no dropped captures, no generation bump). `relocateFolder` still runs the probe and `broadcastState` after it (`index.ts:342-345`), so a hand-deleted identity file is rewritten. Only the toast is skipped (`workspaces-context.tsx:168`). The dialog also reaches the same `onRelocated` through its own call (`workspace-dialog.tsx:145`).
contracts.visible_effect: No "Done. X now points to the new folder" toast when nothing changed. The picker closes with no message.
contracts.failure_mode: The flag is optional and only set on the early return. `index.ts:349` forwards it only when truthy. If the flag is lost, the old misleading toast comes back. No new async call and no new failure path.

contracts.action: An offline edit of a `pendingInit` workspace keeps `pendingInit`, so a later relocate accepts the moved folder
contracts.equivalent_path: `availability()` and `checkRelocate()` both read `pendingInit`: `checkRelocate` at line 855, the probe at lines 702-709 and 743-748.
contracts.before_after: Before: any edit cleared `pendingInit`, even when no identity.json was written. After the drive moved, `checkRelocate` then returned `has-items-no-identity`. Now `pendingInit` is cleared only when `savedToFolder` is true. `pendingIdentity` is set in the else branch (line 638). When the folder shows up with no identity, the probe writes one from the registry's name and color and then clears all pending flags (lines 733-749).
contracts.visible_effect: "Change folder…" works for a workspace that was renamed while its drive was away. The rename survives the move.
contracts.failure_mode: If the moved folder already holds an identity with another id, the probe adopts that id (lines 718-727) and the offline edit is lost. Before this change that case came out as `different`. The earlier thread already records this adoption case as a deferred follow-up, so I don't repeat it as a finding.

thread_replies.reply: Addressed. `relocate.ts:44` returns `unchanged: true`, `index.ts:349` forwards it, and `onRelocated` at `workspaces-context.tsx:168` skips the toast. `relocate.test.ts:158` pins the flag. The one gap is that no test covers the forwarding in `index.ts` or the silent branch in the renderer; I raised that as a separate low-priority note.
Addressed. The same-path early return at `relocate.ts:42-45` runs before `relocateActive`, so no window is asked to save and no capture is dropped. The probe afterwards still runs.

Addressed for the case you chose to fix. `checkRelocate` accepts a folder with `.kaipu` and no identity when the entry is `pendingInit` (`registry.ts:855`). This PR also stops an offline edit from clearing `pendingInit` (`registry.ts:634`), and the new test at `registry-relocate.test.ts:221` covers that path. The adoption case stays a follow-up, as you said.

structuredOutput.summary: The diff has one small gap. The `unchanged` flag flows from `relocate.ts` through `index.ts` into the renderer, where `onRelocated` skips the toast, and `relocate.test.ts` pins it at the main-process level. I found no defect in the changed code. The `registry.ts` change keeps `pendingInit` after an offline edit, which makes the moved-folder relocate work. The probe then writes the identity from the registry's name and color, and the new test covers this path. The gap is that nothing tests the forwarding in `index.ts` or the silent branch in the renderer, so I raised that as a low-priority "consider". The earlier threads on `relocate.ts` and `registry.ts` are addressed.
